description: National Public Transport Gazetteer (NPTG) is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Transport. This is the Government data catalogue page for NPTG. Use this link to visit the actual website for NPTG: NPTG a database of localities (cities, towns, villages and other settlements) in Great Britain. It provides a common frame of reference for the National Public Access Nodes (NaPTAN) schema. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Transport. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, HTML, XML. The portal shows 2022-08-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
